scope.purpose: Map existing page types, indexation controls, data freshness and bounded template handoffs without creating routes or changing production SEO.

inventory_method.route_wrappers: Classified checked-in v2/country/**/index.php wrappers by path shape.
inventory_method.sitemap: Classified every loc in checked-in v2/sitemap.xml.

checked_route_wrappers.note: These are checked-in wrappers, not a claim about every public URL served by the site.

current_checked_sitemap.interpretation: The checked sitemap matches the static controlled launch: three countries, five Turkey resorts, all 36 country-month pages and all 60 Turkey resort-month pages. Dynamic Egypt/Maldives resort launch support exists in source but is not counted unless present in this checked sitemap.

indexation_controls.production_gate: A page is indexable only on anytoour.ru, with SEO_INDEXABLE enabled and an exact normalized path in SEO_INDEXABLE_PATHS.
indexation_controls.preview_gate: Every isolated preview route is forced to noindex regardless of the production allowlist.
indexation_controls.legacy_search_gate: V2_LEGACY_SEARCH routes are forced to noindex.
indexation_controls.canonical_policy: Clean self-canonical on anytoour.ru; compatibility hosts consolidate to https://anytoour.ru/poisk-turov/.
indexation_controls.global_robots_file: v2/robots.txt allows crawling and points to https://anytoour.ru/sitemap.xml; per-page meta robots is the controlled indexation gate.
indexation_controls.hotel_policy: hotel_tours pages accept review records only, force noindex and are absent from the controlled launch and sitemap.

page_type_matrix.intent: Brand entry and start of tour selection.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Editorial shell; live availability begins after the user enters Search3.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: Not present in the checked sitemap or static exact-path launch allowlist.
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Keep one descriptive H1, stable navigation and a crawlable link to the tour search; any indexation change requires separate approval.

page_type_matrix.intent: Browse available destination countries before searching.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Checked-in navigation over 14 country pages; availability and prices are not asserted until search.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: Not present in the checked sitemap or static exact-path launch allowlist.
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Preserve crawlable country links and distinguish navigation copy from live-price claims.

page_type_matrix.intent: Choose a country and continue to a matching tour search.
page_type_matrix.template_or_entry: Country wrappers render through the shared SEO country page and site shell.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Editorial record plus first-party seo_offer_snapshots with expires_at >= NOW(); snapshot readers fail closed without fresh rows.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: 3 of 14 wrappers are in the checked sitemap and static exact-path launch allowlist; the other 11 are existing routes but not part of that checked launch.
page_type_matrix.handoff: Country-scoped Search3 URL with preserved destination identity.
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Render editorial facts independently from offers; label price freshness, keep the destination-specific search CTA and avoid invented availability when snapshots are absent.

page_type_matrix.intent: Evaluate one resort and search within its country/resort identity.
page_type_matrix.template_or_entry: Resort wrappers render through v2/seo-resort-page-v1.php and the shared site shell.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Approved editorial record plus fresh first-party offer snapshots; editorial approval and global indexation remain separate gates.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: 5 of 14 wrappers are in the checked sitemap and static launch; 9 are not in the checked sitemap. Generated Egypt/Maldives resort routes must be assessed only from a validated materialized manifest.
page_type_matrix.handoff: Resort-aware search where available, without manufacturing a second search renderer.
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Keep resort identity visible in title/H1/breadcrumbs and make fallback to country search explicit when the search contract lacks a resort mapping.

page_type_matrix.intent: Find tours to a country within a named departure month.
page_type_matrix.template_or_entry: Month wrappers use v2/seo-seasonal-page-v1.php and the shared shell.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Approved seasonal editorial record; exact page_key snapshot, non-expired offers and current-or-future departures. Price-calendar observations are accepted only within the bounded freshness and coverage rules.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: All 36 checked wrappers are in the checked sitemap and static controlled launch.
page_type_matrix.handoff: Month-bounded Search3 URL; the runtime clamps dates to the selected month and current business date.
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Show the selected month in visible copy and CTA; preserve exact month boundaries, distinguish current prices from general seasonal guidance and fail closed when data is stale.

page_type_matrix.intent: Find tours to one resort within a named departure month.
page_type_matrix.template_or_entry: Resort-month wrappers use the shared seasonal renderer and site shell.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Same exact-key, expiry, future-departure and price-calendar coverage constraints as country-month pages.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: All 60 checked wrappers are in the checked sitemap and static controlled launch.
page_type_matrix.handoff: Resort/month search handoff with exact calendar boundaries.
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Preserve both resort and month identity through breadcrumbs, H1 and search URL; never replace absent fresh offers with unqualified price text.

page_type_matrix.intent: Review one verified hotel identity and continue to a relevant search.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Review-only editorial records with verified hotel/country identity and first-party observations; no supplier request is made by the page reader.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: 0 of 102 are in the checked sitemap. The renderer forces noindex and the controlled launch explicitly excludes hotel_tours.
page_type_matrix.handoff: Hotel-aware search only through the existing protected identity contract.
page_type_matrix.template_owner: SITE with an INT identity dependency
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Remain review/noindex until a separate approval; require stable hotel/country IDs, non-duplicative content, fresh offer sufficiency and an unambiguous search handoff before any launch proposal.

page_type_matrix.intent: Browse currently fresh discounted or low-priced departures.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Reads first-party hot_tours_current rows only where expires_at > NOW(), price > 0 and departure_date is not before the business date; results are deduplicated by departure, hotel, date and nights.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: Not present in the checked sitemap or static exact-path launch allowlist.
page_type_matrix.handoff: Offer-specific Search3 transition using the existing URL contract.
page_type_matrix.template_owner: SITE with an INT data dependency
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Keep stale/empty states explicit and avoid durable landing-page claims based on inherently short-lived rows.

page_type_matrix.intent: Explain the tour-selection journey and guide a user into search.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Static editorial content; no live offer claim is required.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: Not present in the checked sitemap or static exact-path launch allowlist.
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Keep advice useful without duplicating country/month pages; retain a clear search handoff and editorial ownership.

page_type_matrix.intent: Run the primary tour search, compare results, select a tour and continue to booking.
page_type_matrix.template_or_entry: Search3 source and its single current renderer/controller/lifecycle owners.
page_type_matrix.data_and_freshness: Live Tourvisor/API behavior under protected URL, payload, identity and price contracts.
page_type_matrix.current_indexation: Not present in the checked sitemap or controlled SEO launch; preview is always noindex.
page_type_matrix.handoff: This is the destination for country, resort, month, hot and hotel transitions.
page_type_matrix.seo_requirement: Landing templates must pass only validated existing parameters; do not add a second renderer, supplier call or SEO-only API experiment.

bounded_template_handoffs.requirement: For an existing indexable country page, keep editorial content useful when offers are empty, label fresh price observations and preserve a destination-specific Search3 CTA.
For country-month and resort-month pages, make country/resort/month identity consistent across title, H1, breadcrumbs and CTA while keeping exact month-bound search dates.
Continue accepting only the existing validated country/resort/month/hotel URL contract; SEO work must not fork renderer/controller ownership.
Expose freshness and identity only through bounded first-party contracts; SEO pages must not start new supplier collection or infer unknown resort/hotel mappings.

next_safe_candidate.reason: It is already in the exact production allowlist and checked sitemap, has stable destination intent, a shared template, fresh-snapshot fail-closed behavior and an existing Search3 handoff.
bounded_review: Verify useful above-the-fold country intent without relying on a live offer.
Verify any displayed price has a visible freshness qualifier and disappears cleanly when the snapshot is absent.
Verify the CTA preserves the country identity and protected Search3 URL contract.
Verify title, H1, description, breadcrumbs and canonical express one consistent country page identity.

unknowns: Whether a materialized Egypt/Maldives core-resort manifest is active in a production environment cannot be established from the checked sitemap alone.
Search-demand and indexation-performance data are not represented in this source-only inventory.
Physical Safari rendering remains outside this source audit.
deferred: Any production SEO indexation, robots, canonical, redirect or sitemap change.
New API, supplier or resort-identity experiments for SEO.
